data.exact_reserve_text: In 2017, there has been an overall deficit of GBP 4.9m on prior year reserves (2016 deficit of GBP 2.3m). The deficit is primarily driven by premium reductions and reserve increases on the marine and energy classes of business.

named_events.loss_description: Syndicate has material exposure to the Hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria (HIM) in the 2016 and 2017 years of account; a 5% increase in Gross (Net) HIM reserves would result in a GBP 1.7m (GBP 0.1m) increase.

data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2017 were GBP 110.206m. Using the syndicate's gross claims development triangle, there is a net prior-year adverse development (strengthening) of approximately GBP 6.03m (c.5.5% of opening gross reserves) driven by reserve increases, in particular in the marine and energy portfolios. The managing agent reports an overall net deficit on prior year reserves of GBP 4.9m (2016: GBP 2.3m) after reinsurance. The syndicate also notes material exposure to the Hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria which contributes to reserve uncertainty.
raw_causal_phrases: overall deficit of GBP 4.9m on prior year reserves (2016 deficit of GBP 2.3m)
premium reductions and reserve increases on the marine and energy classes of business

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development (gross) was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (claims development table) as the report does not provide a single labelled 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' gross figure. The managing agent narrative reports a net prior year deficit of GBP 4.9m (net of reinsurance); the triangle-derived gross adverse movement is approx. GBP 6.03m. Amounts by LOB for the reserve movement are not quantified in the report (lob movements set from narrative only). Confidence levels reflect calculation from published triangle (0.8) vs explicit balance sheet amounts (1.0).
